Images.Caption: An in-game daytime battlefield scene from Age of Empires IV. The camera faces the back of a blue army, showcasing cavalry units with lances and spears. In the distance, a large red army appears, almost mirroring the blue army. They are prepared to battle in a large open plain, with green trees framing it.

An in-game screenshot of a large red-trimmed civilization during the day from Age of Empires IV. A large stone building is at the center, with a golden glow emitting from it. To the right of this building is the Town Center. The surrounding area is covered in farms, mills, homes, and a long wooden wall.

An in-game daytime screenshot of a battle on sandy terrain from Age of Empires IV. To the right is an army, trimmed in green, with several infantry and war elephants. They are charging to a yellow-trimmed army on the left. The yellow army charges toward their enemies on camelback and on foot.

An in-game 3/4 screenshot of a purple-trimmed Asian civilization from Age of Empires IV. Several small and tall rectangular buildings are scattered about an open hilly plain. A circular building sits at the bottom right of the image. Near it are villages cutting down trees. In the background is a long white stone wall.

A 3/4 in-game screenshot from Age of Empires IV. A high stone wall separates a red-trimmed civilization from the shore. Infantry units walk past the wall, while others stand guard on top of it. Cannons and cavalry are standing guard outside, facing out to an orange-trimmed navy.
A live-action screenshot from Age of Empires IV. A stone memorial is seen for Joan of Arc (Jeanne D'Arc) with carved side profile image of her and her name appearing below with a golden glow.

An Age of Empires IV in-game screenshot showcasing a large yellow-trimmed civilization in a desert environment. Several buildings are divided between the north west and the south east with a dirt path cutting through the center. A few cavalry and infantry are traveling up this path, passing by villagers working on a gold vein.

An in-game daytime screenshot of a battle in a hilly open plain from Age of Empires IV. To the right is an army, trimmed in yellow, with several infantry and calvary units. They are charging to a blue-trimmed army on the left, that mirrors them. A large castle appears in the back left corner.
An Age of Empires IV in-game screenshot of a large yellow-trimmed navy traveling across a large body of water during the day.

An Age of Empires IV in-game screenshot of an island with a large red-trimmed stone castle on the south west shoreline. Villagers, cavalry and infantry are all running toward the opposite side of the island, just out of frame.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
For years you’ve battled armies and made history your story. Now it’s time to make history once more with a new breakthrough in strategy gaming – introducing Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition now available on Xbox consoles.* 

Enjoy innovative ways to play one of the most beloved strategy games ever with native inputs for Xbox controller, console-specific user interface, and a new tutorial designed for first time players to help achieve easy setup and success. Additionally, if you prefer playing with a keyboard and mouse you can easily plug directly into your console. 

Return to History – The past is prologue as you are immersed in a rich historical setting of 10 diverse civilizations across the world from the English to the Chinese to the Delhi Sultanate in your quest for victory. Build cities, manage resources, and lead your troops to battle on land and at sea in 4 distinct campaigns with 35 missions that span across 500 years of history from the Dark Ages up to the Renaissance.

Choose Your Path to Greatness with Historical Figures – Live the adventures of Joan of Arc in her quest to defeat the English, or command mighty Mongol troops as Genghis Khan in his conquest across Asia. The choice is yours – and every decision you make will determine the outcome of history. 

Challenge the World – Jump online to compete, cooperate or spectate with up to 7 of your friends in PVP and PVE multiplayer modes on Xbox One Series X I S and up to 3 friends on Xbox One.  (Online console multiplayer requires Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or Xbox Live Gold, subscriptions sold separately.) 

Play Custom Games with Mods (Beta) - Play custom skirmish and multiplayer maps, unique mission scenarios, data driven tuning packs and new modes of play for Age of Empires IV. 

An Age for All Players – Age of Empires IV is an inviting experience for new players with a console-specific tutorial that teaches the essence of real-time strategy and a Campaign Story Mode designed for first time players to help achieve easy setup and success, yet is challenging enough for veteran players with new game mechanics, evolved strategies, and combat techniques.

*This content is available on Xbox consoles as a free download for current Xbox Game Pass subscribers and owners of Age of Empires IV on PC, excluding Steam purchasers.
